sloka: यादृशी परिषत् तत्र तादृशो दूताअगतः ।ध्रुवम् अद्य एव माम् राजा यौवराज्ये अभिषेक्ष्यति ॥२-१६-१९॥
transliteration: yādṛśī pariṣat tatra tādṛśo dūtāagataḥ ।dhruvam adya eva mām rājā yauvarājye abhiṣekṣyati ॥2-16-19॥

translations.english: There worthy of the council of the king and the queen, a befitting messenger has come. Assuredly the king will consecrate me as heirapparent this very day.
